name: Perf Meter
summary: A small movable meter for your framerate, home and world latency and addon memory, colour-coded so trouble stands out.
logoPrompt: A round brass speedometer gauge standing in the centre, its needle pointing into a glowing green zone next to yellow and red zones

cover.tagline: Your game's pulse in one small line.
bullets: Addon memory with a top five

description: **Perf Meter puts your framerate, your latency and the memory your addons use into one small line you can place anywhere on screen.**
- Framerate, home and world latency and total addon memory in one line.
- Each value turns green, yellow or red, so problems stand out.
- Hover over the meter to see the five addons that use the most memory.
- Drag it anywhere and lock it; the place is saved for all your characters.
Type `/perfmeter` (or `/pm`) to show or hide the meter, `/pm lock` or `/pm unlock` to fix or free it and `/pm reset` to bring it back to the top of the screen.
- Works on Retail. No combat data.
- Green framerate from 45 fps, red below 25. Green latency below 100 ms, red from 250 ms. Green memory below 200 MB, red from 500 MB. Yellow in between.
- Values update once per second; the game itself measures latency every 30 seconds.
- Addon memory is measured every 15 seconds and never during combat, because measuring it is expensive.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
